svg.aria-label: Three panels, for a sine burst, a square burst and a chirp. Each shows the 64-sample input waveform above eight strip-chart traces, one per wire, each in its own pen. The sine and square panels look nearly alike.

g.text: one held-out waveform, 64 samples, one per slot.
the eight wires answering it, after tanh, each plotted across its own row in its own pen.
sine and square are the only pair either arm ever mixes up; every chirp, pulse and AM pulse is classified correctly
